# printenv

Print environment variables through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/printenv

moonx cli/printenv PATH
```

Print all entries without operands, or each requested value in order. Missing variables produce a nonzero status.

## Notes

- The launcher controls which environment variables are visible.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
